item.text: South Australia’s Independent Commissioner Against Corruption surveyed state and local government public officers to identify integrity risks and areas for improvement.
item.support:
The survey was 
made available to public officers in both state and local government.

item.text: The report analysed quantitative responses about reporting, perceived workplace risks and experiences of inappropriate conduct.
item.support:
It deals with 
an analysis of the quantitative survey data.

item.text: The Commissioner reported widespread anxiety about reporting and low confidence that agencies would act or protect reporters.
item.support:
The survey identified widespread and significant concern amongst public officers 
about reporting impropriety, both internally and to an outside agency.

item.text: The Commissioner urged agencies to improve safe reporting and examine differences between the views of leaders and other staff.
item.support:
There is a disconnect of perceptions and attitudes between ‘Senior’ and 
‘Other’ staff.
